verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for payment platforms, since some payment and orchestration products ship self-hostable deployments, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes a hosted SaaS reached through APIs, SDKs, plugins, a vendor-run status page and a hosted payment page. Nothing in the pack shows a deployable, self-hostable version of the core product, and the test-key sandbox is a hosted test mode, not self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
